opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then save summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination and date range, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels, and a Viator activity, then record a trip summary note.
steps: Google Flights: set origin, destination, departure/return dates, search, note cheapest flight
Booking.com: enter destination, select dates, search, open top hotel, note name and price
Viator: search for the main attraction tour, open top result, note title and price
Open notes app, create new note 'Trip <city> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., activity...' and press Enter

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona

steps: Search package A on PyPI and open its page
Click the Source/Repository link to get GitHub stars
Create a note 'A version date stars license vs B ...'

opportunities.name: Browser feature support lookup and reply email draft
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse and MDN, then compose a reply email to a person with the supported version and MDN docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read the version for the browser
Search MDN for the feature and open the doc page
Open mail compose, fill To, Subject, Body with version and docs URL
